page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top. Heading below it, then running text in paragraphs. A left-margin note in italic sits at the foot of the text, beside the last lines. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.head: II. Quis modus externus, & internus Resurrectionis.
main_text.p: Externum modum quid voces : ostende ex Circumstantiis historiæ ab evangelistis descriptę externis, seu extra personam resurgentis positis, & ad ipsum resurgendi actum non pertinentib.
1. Mulieres valde mane ad sepulcrum veniunt, & his primum resurrectio Christi demonstratur.
Breviter explica causas: 1. quia primæ mortem in mundum invexerunt. Primæ igitur resurrectionis nuncium accipiunt. 2. In morte vehementer doluerunt. Par igitur fuit, ut primò gaude[?]ret[?].
Transfertur ad thesin: Zelus mulierum: Sed simul ostendatur earum inconsiderantia, quod sero demum de lapide revolvendo solicitæ sint.

Thesis: Cum non ex fide agitur, multa sæpe imprudenter committitur[?]: & Deo dari, quod non requirit: Sic mulieres ferunt aromata, fidem non afferunt. Sic in Papatu dari Deo missas, ferias, vota, at fidem, & obedientiam non dari.

II. Terræmotu facto angelus descendit de cœlo, & revolvit lapidem. Dic terræmotus & revolutionis non causam: Etsi probabile in terræmotu Christum resurrexisse: non tamen ideo angelus revolvit lapidem ut egrederetur. Hiero-nymus : Angelum non putemus iccirco venisse, ut aperiret sepulcrum Domino resurgenti, & revolveret lapidem: Sed postquam Dominus resurrexit hora, Epistola ad Hed. q.6.

page.notes: The left-margin note reads "Epistola ad" with "Hed. q.6." below it; the note's first word "nymus" continues the main-text word "Hiero-", which is probably Hieronymus. The reading "Hed." is doubtful. "gaude[?]ret" is uncertain at the letters after "gaud" (printed "gaudcret"); "gauderet" is the likely word. "committitur" is doubtful (printed form close to "committitti"). Long s is written as plain s throughout. The heading is set in roman, numbered II. The last word "qua" is the catchword at lower right.
